commands.command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
f=Path('.pi/frontier.json')
data=json.loads(f.read_text())
print(json.dumps(data,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
for group, paths in {
 'scored_worktree': subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','src/point_add'],text=True).splitlines(),
 'trusted_worktree': subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','src/bin','Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','.cargo'],text=True).splitlines(),
}.items():
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 for raw in paths:
  p=Path(raw)
  if p.is_file():
   b=p.read_bytes(); h.update(raw.encode()+b'\0'+hashlib.sha256(b).digest())
 print(group+'_tree_sha256='+h.hexdigest())
PY
commands.label: frontier-identity-and-source-hashes

commands.command: find . -path './target' -prune -o -type f \( -name 'ops.bin' -o -name 'score.json' \) -print | sort | while IFS= read -r p; do shasum -a 256 "$p"; if [ "$(basename "$p")" = score.json ]; then printf '%s\n' "--- $p ---"; cat "$p"; fi; done
commands.label: ops-hashes-and-score-artifacts
